scope: 60 newly recognized components (38 Trainers, 15 attacks, 7 Abilities) and 56 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Revavroom official cost rulings
sources.checkedFacts: Rumbling Engine accepts Special Energy, but cannot activate with an empty deck or seven cards in hand.

sources.title: Revavroom six-card hand ruling
sources.checkedFacts: At six cards in hand the Energy cost is paid first and one card is drawn.

sources.title: Iris Fighting Spirit official ruling
sources.checkedFacts: Eight cards in hand cannot play Iris: removing the Supporter and one cost still leaves six, so no draw occurs.

sources.title: Milo official rulings
sources.checkedFacts: Milo alone cannot be played; two cards may be discarded with only one deck card; a discarded Prism Star still contributes to drawing.

sources.title: Milo English text
sources.checkedFacts: Up to two physical hand cards; draw two for each card actually discarded.

sources.title: First-player Supporter restriction
sources.checkedFacts: The first-player first-turn Supporter restriction applies independently of Lillies first-own-turn reward.

sources.title: Official advanced rulebook
sources.checkedFacts: Costs must be fully affordable before activation. Mandatory later effects do as much as possible; filtered private searches may fail to find.

notes: Lunala-GX and Bastiodon retain unsupported whole-card status; their completed components are tested directly from partial combat entries.
Lillies Determination me1_en_119 is existing hand-reviewed data and remains preserved.
Typed Bench switching was excluded until a scoped switch contract is implemented.
